How Disney makes GIANT Christmas ornaments! 🚥🎄 #DisneyUnscripted
Step behind the magic in our Disney World Christmas Trees episode of Disney Unscripted! 🎄

Discover how Walt Disney World Resort transforms into a holiday wonderland overnight. In this exclusive behind-the-scenes look, watch as Disney Holiday Services cast members work tirelessly to install dozens of iconic Christmas trees across the parks and resorts. From Main Street, U.S.A. to EPCOT and Disney’s Hollywood Studios, see the incredible logistics, teamwork, and holiday spirit that make this overnight transformation possible.

Whether you’re a Disney fan, planning your next holiday visit, or just love festive magic, this episode is your ultimate peek behind the curtain!
